name: Nullweave Cubicle Blouse — Standard Drape
description: A collarless pull-on blouse in pale sand or muted teal, made from Nullweave's budget synth-silk that photographs well under fluorescent light. The back panel has a wide pleat to accommodate basic spinal rig frames up to Class 2. Mass-produced in runs of ten thousand; the wearer's floor likely has six identical blouses in rotation.
functionality: Spinal rig back-pleat accommodation, wrinkle-resistant fabric, machine washable.
what_it_says: You bought this because it was on the approved vendor list and it was the cheapest option that still looked presentable.
story_hooks: Nullweave batches from lot 7-C have a dye flaw that makes them glow faintly under UV — wearers have been flagged by building security sensors.
A clerk wore this blouse every day for three years; the pleat is permanently stretched to the exact shape of a rig she no longer has.
